endpoints.summary: Score a single (model, native) pair via DockQ; returns DockQ's JSON output.
endpoints.description: Score a single (model, native) pair via DockQ; returns DockQ's JSON output.

request_fields.name: name
request_fields.description: Output basename; appears in result paths (output/<name>.json for the single endpoint, output/scores.csv key column for batch). Restricted to [A-Za-z0-9_.-] (no slashes/spaces).

request_fields.name: mapping
request_fields.description: DockQ --mapping flag, format MODELCHAINS:NATIVECHAINS. Use `*` as a wildcard; e.g. ':HL' restricts the native interfaces to H-L.

request_fields.name: small_molecule
request_fields.description: Pass --small_molecule. Required when scoring PDB/CIF inputs that contain HEM / cofactor / ligand chains.

request_fields.name: capri_peptide
request_fields.description: Pass --capri_peptide. Use only for peptide-protein scoring; DockQ explicitly warns the score is unreliable in this mode.

request_fields.name: no_align
request_fields.description: Pass --no_align. Skips sequence alignment; trusts residue numbering directly. Faster, but only safe when model + native share the exact residue indexing.

request_fields.name: allowed_mismatches
request_fields.description: Number of allowed mismatches when mapping model→native sequences (--allowed_mismatches).

request_fields.name: optDockQF1
request_fields.description: Pass --optDockQF1. Optimizes the chain mapping for DockQ_F1 instead of DockQ.

request_fields.name: n_cpu
request_fields.description: Override DOCKQ_DEFAULT_N_CPU for this call. Forwarded to DockQ's --n_cpu.

examples.title: basic protein-protein scoring
examples.notes: Result lands in output/demo.json once the job completes.

examples.title: antibody-antigen with explicit chain mapping
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/score -F model=@design.pdb -F native=@reference.pdb -F mapping=HLA:BCX -F name=ab_ag
examples.notes: `mapping` follows DockQ's MODELCHAINS:NATIVECHAINS format. Wildcards (`*`) allowed.

examples.title: small-molecule complex (mmCIF input)
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/score -F model=@1HHO_hem.cif -F native=@2HHB_hem.cif -F small_molecule=true -F mapping=:ABEFG -F name=hem
examples.notes: Required for HEM / cofactor / ligand chains; otherwise their interfaces are ignored.

endpoints.summary: Score N candidate models against 1 reference native.
endpoints.description:
Score N candidate models against 1 reference native.

Models come either as repeated `models` uploads OR as a single zip
referenced by `models_zip_uri` (oss://, file://, job://, http(s)://) — the
gateway uses the zip form since it can't multipart-upload the `models` list.

Per-model JSONs land in `output/per_model/<basename>.json`; the sorted
summary is `output/scores.csv`. Models that errored show up in
`output/failed.csv` (job still completes successfully if at least one
model produced a valid score).

examples.title: rank N candidate designs against one reference
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/score_batch -F native=@reference_complex.pdb -F models=@design_001.pdb -F models=@design_002.pdb -F models=@design_003.pdb -F sort_by=DockQ -F name=batch1
examples.notes: scores.csv lists models sorted by DockQ (descending); raw per-model JSONs under output/per_model/. Models that errored land in failed.csv.

examples.title: chain mapping shared across all models
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/score_batch -F native=@ab_native.pdb -F models=@cand_01.pdb -F models=@cand_02.pdb -F mapping=HLA:BCX -F sort_by=DockQ
examples.notes: `mapping` is forwarded to every DockQ invocation; cuts mapping-enumeration time substantially.

job_lifecycle.poll_recommendation: Poll the status endpoint every 5–120 s until status ∈ {'completed', 'failed'}. On failure, JobInfo.error_summary holds a one-line exception summary and error_tail holds the trailing ~4 KB of the subprocess log — usually enough for triage without a separate /log fetch.
job_lifecycle.restart_semantics: Jobs survive process and FC instance restarts via a `job.json` sidecar in each job directory. Jobs that were RUNNING at the moment of restart are downgraded to FAILED with failure_kind='interrupted'.

nas_layout.cross_instance_consistency: When multiple FC instances mount the same NAS at jobs_base_dir, all of them can see each other's jobs via read-through cache on GET. Writes (create/update) only happen on the instance that owns the subprocess.
nas_layout.cross_service_sharing: Other bioagent services mounted on the same NAS can read this service's output files directly by path, avoiding HTTP round-trips. Example: another service does `Path('/data/rfantibody_jobs/<id>/output/file.qv').read_bytes()`.

tool_outputs.score: output/<name>.json — DockQ's native JSON output for the single (model, native) pair.
tool_outputs.score_batch: output/scores.csv (sorted summary, one row per model) + output/per_model/<basename>.json (raw DockQ JSON per model). output/failed.csv lists models that errored (if any).
tool_outputs.note: Use GET /api/jobs/{id}/files to enumerate; download a single file via /api/jobs/{id}/file/{relpath} or zip the whole dir via /download.

input_uri_schemes.model_uri / native_uri: URI alternatives to the single-endpoint `model` / `native` uploads.
input_uri_schemes.models_zip_uri: Batch only: URI to a zip of candidate model structures (.pdb/.cif/.gz), extracted flat as the `models` set. Use when `models` can't be uploaded (e.g. via the gateway, which dispatches form fields only).
input_uri_schemes.job://<id>/<file>: Re-use a file from a prior dockq job (or any other bioagent service that wrote to NAS).
input_uri_schemes.file:///abs/path: Direct NAS path; works across services on the shared mount.
input_uri_schemes.oss://<bucket>/<key>: Alibaba Cloud OSS object (needs OSS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / _SECRET env vars).
Generic URL, including OSS signed URLs.

scoring_legend.DockQ: 0–1, overall docking quality. <0.23 incorrect / 0.23–0.49 acceptable / 0.49–0.80 medium / ≥0.80 high quality.
scoring_legend.iRMSD: Interface residue RMSD (Å); lower is better.
scoring_legend.LRMSD: Ligand RMSD over the smaller chain (Å); lower is better.
scoring_legend.fnat: Fraction of native contacts recovered; higher is better.
scoring_legend.fnonnat: Fraction of predicted contacts that are non-native; lower is better.
scoring_legend.clashes: Number of clashing interface residues (<2 Å) in the model.

config_tips.mapping: Format MODELCHAINS:NATIVECHAINS. For antibody-antigen scoring with model chains H,L,A and native B,C,X, use `--mapping HLA:BCX`. Use `:HL` to restrict native interfaces to H–L only.
config_tips.small_molecule: Required when scoring PDB/CIF inputs that contain HEM / cofactor / small-molecule chains. Without this flag DockQ ignores those interfaces.
config_tips.no_align: Skip sequence alignment and trust residue numbering directly. Faster, but ONLY safe when model + native share identical residue indexing (e.g. both come from the same crystal structure or pipeline).
config_tips.n_cpu: Forwarded to DockQ's --n_cpu (parallelism for chain-mapping enumeration within a single call, not across batch models). Default 4 fits a 4 vCPU FC instance.
config_tips.sort_by: scores.csv summary column. Defaults to DockQ (descending). For RMSD-style metrics the sort is still descending in the CSV — agents should re-sort client-side if ascending order is preferred.

endpoints_summary./api/score_batch: 1 reference native vs N candidate models; output/scores.csv + per_model/*.json.

batch_limits.expected_runtime: DockQ runs ~1–10 s per protein-protein pair on 4 vCPUs; batch of 100 ~3–15 min.
